t: This is Burlington House, on Piccadilly in Mayfair. It began as a private mansion, first English Baroque and then Neo-Palladian, owned by the Earls of Burlington. The British government bought it, and it was significantly expanded in the mid-nineteenth century. Today the Royal Academy and five learned societies occupy much of the building. Charles Cavendish, later the third Baron Chesham, was born here in 1850. He was a soldier, courtier and Conservative politician, and the last Master of the Buckhounds.
